roles.name: Game Guide (SA)
roles.description: Designs the run from the training room — knows every floor's tricks and keeps the solution alive to the next stairwell.

roles.name: Crawl Leader (PM)
roles.description: Holds the party together, watches the floor timer, and answers to the showrunners.

roles.name: Senior Crawler (SCC)
roles.description: Leads the build with whatever the floor drops — turns improvised tools into working delivery.

roles.name: Crawler (CC)
roles.description: Carries discovery and configuration room by room under the senior crawler's lead.

roles.name: Cookbook Scribe (BA)
roles.description: Writes down what each floor demands and what the party promised — translates between the client and the crew.

roles.name: PR Agent (SMCC)
roles.description: Runs the campaigns — keeps the viewers, the sponsors and the Princess Posse engaged and converting.

_realmNotes: Dungeon Crawler Carl realms follow the crawl: the tutorial floor (tutorial-tunnels), the Over City circus (overcity-circus), the Iron Tangle subway floor (iron-tangle), dungeon services (saferoom-network, desperado-club, training-room), the production side (borant-studios), past Cookbook editions (cookbook-archives, Historical) and the Butcher's Masquerade gala (butchers-masquerade, open deal — no project yet). Internal realm is training-room. All offsets are relative to the project start; negative windowOffsetWeeks = past weeks get Time Entries, future weeks get Schedules.
